senses.gloss: m. (σημαντήρ, σημαντήριον) seal, signet, stamp. Pesik. B’shall., p. 82ᵇ חותמו … וס׳ שלו her husband’s signature (to the marriage contract) and his seal; Cant. R. to IV, 12.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:4:3">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>סמנטרין</he>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>סימנט׳</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:5">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אם אין סִימַנְטְרִי וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="O00736"><he>סינטרי</he></cite>, corr. acc.) unless the invited guests show my seal (on the invitation card) &c.; a. e.
